description: Hold a Standard Hourly slot ($425.00), or the first session of an Executive 1:1 Subscription and its recurring monthly day and time, for 30 minutes and return a secure payment link; the booking is confirmed only when payment succeeds. Behavior: this tool creates a temporary hold and charges nothing itself; an unpaid hold expires after 30 minutes. It is not idempotent: call it once per booking attempt. Usage: call check_availability first and pass a slot returned there, with the customer's details. Give the returned payment link to the customer, then use confirm_booking with the returned prepareToken to learn whether payment completed; this tool does not confirm bookings.

email.description: Customer email address. The payment receipt and the calendar invitation are sent to this address.

name.description: Customer full name, e.g. Jordan Lee. Used on the booking and the calendar invitation.

need.description: What the customer wants to cover in the session, in the customer's own words; a sentence or two is enough.

pattern.description: Executive 1:1 only: standing monthly pattern (ordinal 1-4, or -1 for last; weekday 1-4 for Monday to Thursday; hour 10-16 Pacific Time). Defaults to the first session's pattern.

phone.description: Customer phone number, any standard format.

service.description: Service id from list_services; defaults to standard-hourly. Use executive-subscription to start an Executive 1:1 Subscription.

slot.description: Slot start from check_availability, ISO 8601 datetime in Pacific Time, e.g. 2027-01-20T10:00:00-08:00. Must be a slot check_availability returned.

title.description: Customer job title, e.g. VP Operations.

name: prepare_booking

holdExpiresAt.description: When the 30-minute hold expires, ISO 8601 datetime.

next.description: Next steps for the agent, as plain text.

paymentUrl.description: Hosted payment link (URL) for the human to complete payment.

plan.description: Executive 1:1 only: the recurring monthly pattern.

prepareToken.description: Token identifying this prepared booking; pass it to confirm_booking.

sessions.description: Executive 1:1 only: scheduled sessions, each with session number, start (ISO 8601 UTC datetime), and display text.

slot.description: The held slot, as returned by the booking service.

title: Prepare booking
